description: Set the IPv4 configuration of a host: PC-PT and Server-PT (Laptop-PT and Printer-PT are accepted but unverified). PTBuilder configures only the FastEthernet0 interface. dhcp: true enables DHCP (ip, mask and gateway are ignored; dns is kept). Otherwise ip and mask are required; mask accepts 255.255.255.0 or /24. Replaces the host's previous IP configuration. For routers and switches use configure_device instead.

dhcp.description: true = obtain the address by DHCP (ip/mask/gateway are ignored).

dns.description: DNS server IPv4 address (kept with DHCP too).

ip.description: IPv4 address, e.g. 192.168.1.10 (or 192.168.1.10/24 to include the mask).

name.description: Device name, e.g. R1, S1, PC1 (case-insensitive).

name: configure_pc
title: Configure host IP
